jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in Adipose stem cell biology
jobs.description:
The Mandrup group invites applications from outstanding candidates for a Postdoctoral position in our group based at the Functional Genomics & Metabolism Research Unit, Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark. The position is funded by the Villum Experiment programme. The position is offered for a duration of two years and will be available from 1st of February 2027 or as soon as possible before 9th of March 2027.

Project and Research Environment
The Mandrup group investigates the molecular mechanisms governing transcriptional control of adipocyte differentiation and stem cell fate in adipose tissue, with a particular focus on how niche signals are integrated at the chromatin and transcriptional level to instruct progenitor cell fate decisions. The successful candidate will be primarily embedded in a Villum Experiment-funded project, led by Senior Postdoc Babukrishna Maniyadath, addressing how signals in the adipose tissue regulate adipogenic commitment of stem cells - a question that remains largely uncharted at the molecular level. The project draws on precision co-culture systems, single-cell genomics, live-cell imaging, si/CRISPR-based perturbation, and synthetic contact-mimicking surfaces, working exclusively with primary human and mouse cells. There will also be opportunities to contribute to related projects within the group.

Job Description
The Postdoctoral Fellow will drive experimental activities across the core areas of the project and contribute to its scientific development. The position requires both intellectual independence and close collaboration within the research group.

Key responsibilities include

• 
Planning and executing experiments across the project’s core areas, with a high degree of independence and scientific rigor

• 
Applying and developing genomic, imaging, and functional perturbation approaches to address key questions in niche signaling and progenitor fate

• 
Contributing to multi-omics data generation, integration, and interpretation

• 
Contributing to experimental design and to the development of novel approaches relevant to the project’s goals

In addition, the candidate will

• 
Contribute to supervision and mentoring of students

• 
Participate in preparation of scientific publications and dissemination of results

• 
Actively contribute to a collaborative, ambitious, and supportive research environment

Qualifications
We are seeking a highly motivated candidate with a strong experimental background in cell and molecular biology and a keen interest in understanding how direct cell-cell communication shapes adipogenic fate decisions.

Required qualifications

• 
A PhD in cell biology, molecular biology, biochemistry, or a related field

• 
Strong background in wet lab experiment planning and execution including mammalian cell culture and molecular biology techniques.

• 
Familiarity with transcriptomics data generation and analysis

• 
Ability to independently drive research projects

• 
Strong collaborative and communication skills

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English

In addition, the following qualifications are relevant but not required

• 
Hands-on experience with adipose biology, stromal/progenitor cell systems, or immune biology

• 
Experience in primary cells or ex vivo systems

• 
Experience with single-cell RNA-seq or single-cell ATAC-seq - from experimental design and library preparation through to bioinformatic analysis

• 
Experience with quantitative image analysis workflows

• 
Experience with biomaterial engineering, surface functionalization, or synthetic biology approaches relevant to cell–cell contact mimicry

• 
Proficiency in computational biology, bioinformatics pipelines, and R or Python for single-cell data analysis and visualization

We offer

• 
A position in a highly focused, externally funded project at the frontier of niche biology and stem cell fate control

• 
Access to state-of-the-art infrastructure within single-cell genomics, live imaging, and molecular biology

• 
An international, highly collaborative, and dynamic research environment

• 
Strong support for scientific development and career progression

• 
Competitive salary and comprehensive social benefits

The Mandrup Group
The Mandrup Group has a long-standing interest in the detailed molecular mechanisms governing transcriptional control of adipocyte differentiation. We apply a variety of sequencing-based, computational, and molecular technologies, combined with loss- and gain-of-function strategies to study the mechanisms and role of the 3D chromatin architecture, the crosstalk between enhancers in enhancer communities and the role of specific transcription factors.
You will work closely together with other postdoctoral fellows and PhD students in the group, and you will also be expected to collaborate with colleagues in the Center of Excellence in Functional Genomics and Tissue Plasticity (ATLAS) and Center of Adipocyte Signaling (ADIPOSIGN), both directed by Susanne Mandrup. Furthermore, you will be able to benefit from the many international collaborations of our group.

The Functional Genomics & Metabolism Research Unit
The Mandrup Group is located in the Functional Genomics & Metabolism Research Unit at the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, SDU. The research unit currently hosts eight independent research groups focusing on how specific cell types regulate gene expression and how this affects the development and function of cells and tissues. Thus, our research aims to better understand how genes regulate human physiology and diseases such as obesity, fatty liver disease, cancer, and diabetes. The research unit constitutes an international, ambitious, highly dynamic, and well-equipped working environment. The unit and the department have state-of-the-art facilities for next-generation sequencing, single-cell transcriptomics and epigenomics, flow cytometry, mass spectrometry, metabolomics, bioimaging, cell culture, and dietary intervention and transgenic mouse models. The unit maintains strategic research alliances with Odense University Hospital (OUH). This provides a highly stimulating research environment with numerous opportunities for learning and developing new ideas.

Application deadline: 3. January 2027 at 23:59 hours local Danish time
Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Riemannian Computing
jobs.description:
Job description
The computational science section of the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science (IMADA) at the University of Southern Denmark invites applications for a PhD position associated with the research project “Riemannian Computing for Symplectic Structures” funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark (DFF). The position is to be filled earliest by March 1, 2027, and latest by Sep. 1, 2027, for a period of three years. 
The project concerns Riemannian computing applications on nonlinear matrix manifolds. The successful candidate will work at the interface of Riemannian geometry, numerical linear algebra, and scientific computing, and will develop and analyze new geometric methods and efficient numerical algorithms for data processing with symplectic structures. 

IMADA has the unique feature of bringing mathematicians and computer scientists together within a single department. The department is home to many ongoing externally funded research projects and provides a vibrant environment for junior researchers across the disciplines of mathematics, computer science, AI, data science, and quantum computing.

We are seeking curious candidates with a desire to make significant contributions to science, and a specific interest in both fundamental and computational aspects of Riemannian computing on matrix manifolds. We encourage female researchers to apply.

As the project lies at the intersection of numerical analysis, Riemannian geometry and scientific computing, applicants should have a strong background in at least one of these areas and should be ready to acquire knowledge in other ones. A background spanning all three areas would be an advantage. Scientific programming skills are considered a plus. We also expect excellent spoken and written communication skills in English.

Application deadline: 15. January 2027 at 23:59 hours local Danish time
Please see the full call, including how to apply, on www.sdu.dk

jobs.occupation: Two-Year funded Postdoc Position in mRNA Therapeutics and Cardiometabolic Disease
jobs.description:
The Opportunity: We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Postdoc to be a cornerstone and formative members of a new initiative at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) focused on messenger RNA therapeutics in cardiometabolic diseases.
This is a unique opportunity to lead a critical project at the intersection of mRNA biology, advanced model systemics and disease therapeutics. You will be able to contribute to our vision to translate basic disease findings into novel mRNA delivery approaches to improve the lives of people suffering from cardiometabolic disease.

This two-year position (with the wish and possibility of extension) is ideal for a scientist with deep technical expertise and passion of alleviating disease burden, who thrives on enabling research, developing new technologies, and mentoring scientists.

Our Vision: To pioneer messenger RNA-based platforms to achieve gene gain-of-function/activity in liver of preclinical rodent models and a passion for our longterm aim of alleviating cardiometabolic disease burden in human patients.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Setting up, validating, and testing in vitro LNP-mRNA platforms to delivery human CMD gene candidates.

• 
Translating these approaches in diet-induced obese rodent models.

• 
Writing and implementing SOPs, managing critical instruments.

• 
Hands-on training and guiding students and technical staff.

• 
Collaborating and technical lead on projects, including designing experiments, troubleshooting problems, and generating the high-quality data that drives our projects forward.

Your Profile:

• 
PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, cell biology, physiology, or a related field with a strong methodological focus. 

• 
High-impact first author publications, patents and/or conference proceedings

• 
Satisfaction in training academic researchers and helping them succeed in their projects. 

• 
A strong collaborator with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

• 
Excellent communicator (written and verbal) with a clear passion for translating basic findings into therapeutic approaches and an ability to communicate with industrial, innovation and academic collaborators.

Technical Expertise: You have demonstrated, hands-on expertise in several of the following:

• 
Experience with mRNA-based platforms in cardiometabolic cells and tissues.

• 
Rodent models of metabolic disease and expertise in animal husbandry.

• 
Biochemical assays to measure intracellular metabolite fluxes

What We Offer: You'll be joining a prolific, internationally recognised research group at the Functional Genomics and Metabolic (FGM) Section at the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular at SDU. Our group focusses on fundamental principles in gene regulation, epigenetics, noncoding RNAs, and adipose biology, with a strong to developing the next generation of RNA-based medicines (Kornfeld Nature 2013, Oliverio Nature Cell Biology 2016, Awazawa Nature Medicine 2017, Schmidt Nature Communications 2018, Pradas-Juni Nature Communications 2020, Park Nature Metabolism 2021, Engelhard iScience 2023, Khani-Topel Nature Metabolism 2024, Kaul Nature Metabolism 2025).

We provide:

• 
A stable, supportive, and collaborative research environment.

• 
Rich inter-sectorial collaborations with industrial and academic partners.

• 
A position working at the intersection of target discovery and innovation.

• 
Access to state-of-the-art facilities for proteomics, molecular biology, and in vivo studies.

• 
Affiliation with the Novo Nordisk Foundation Centre for Adipocyte Signalling (ADIPOSIGN), an international research consortium at FGM with focus on multi-omic mapping of cardiometabolic (adipocyte) dysfunction

• 
Affiliation with the newly formed NNF Centre for Modelling of Human Cardiometabolic Diseases (HICONIC)

• 
Dedicated mentorship and career development.

• 
A competitive salary and benefits package in accordance with Danish regulations.

jobs.occupation: Staff scientist position at the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology at SDU
jobs.description:
A position as staff scientist (A-TAP salary level) is available at the Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology, University of Southern Denmark, Odense, from 1st of March 2027. Application deadline is 10th of January 2027.

You will be part of the research groups of Associate Professors Anne Loft (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/anne-loft-lab) and Søren Fisker Schmidt (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/functional-genomics/medarbejdere/medarbejdere-sfs), who explore how healthy and unhealthy adipose tissue contribute to obesity-related comorbidities, such as metabolic-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), using single cell sequencing-based methods. The groups are also developing optimized tools for targeting specific cellular subpopulations within adipose tissue. Both groups are part of the Functional Genomics & Metabolism Research Unit, an international and collaborative research environment of eight independent research groups focusing on the mechanisms controlling cell plasticity in metabolism and disease.

We are looking for a highly motivated staff scientist (PhD in molecular biology, biomedicine or related fields), who will contribute to and support research activities across the two research groups and play a central role in the day-to-day management and research infrastructure of the groups. The position includes involvement in multiple research projects, implementation and support of advanced experimental and analytical methods, coordination of research-related activities, and training and guidance of students and other group members. The position may also include limited participation in teaching activities at the department.

Qualifications

We are looking for a highly motivated, organised and collaborative staff scientist with

• 
A PhD degree in life sciences (molecular biology, biomedicine or related fields)

• 
Expertise in functional omics technologies, including single-cell analyses.

• 
Experience with bioinformatics analyses of omics data.

• 
Experience with mouse work, metabolic research and histology.

• 
Strong communication, collaborative and organisational skills.

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English.

About the Department

The Department of Biochemistry and Molecular Biology is part of the Faculty of Science at the University of Southern Denmark in Odense. The department provides an international, interdisciplinary, and innovative research environment, bringing together researchers, technical and administrative staff, and students.

Our research focuses on the fundamental molecular, cellular, and biochemical processes underlying cellular growth, development, and interactions in living organisms. We combine advanced analytical and biochemical technologies with computational approaches to investigate gene organization, protein structure and function, and membrane composition and dynamics. Our research contributes to a deeper understanding of fundamental biological processes and the molecular mechanisms underlying diseases such as diabetes, cancer, neurodegenerative disorders, and bacterial infections.

Applications must include

• 
Cover letter describing your motivation for applying and your most relevant qualifications.

• 
CV

• 
Certificate

For further information, please contact Anne Loft (anlo@bmb.sdu.dk) or Søren Fisker Schmidt (sfs@bmb.sdu.dk).

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.occupation: Experienced TIG Welder Wanted for Our Production Team in Ringkøbing
jobs.description:
EagleBurgmann KE A/S in Ringkøbing is looking for an experienced TIG Welder to join our production team. We manufacture high-quality expansion joints and are seeking a skilled professional with experience in TIG welding of stainless steel. The work is performed using semi-automatic welding fixtures, where precision, quality, and consistency are essential.

EagleBurgmann KE A/S employs approximately 500 people globally, with production and assembly operations across 11 locations worldwide. We are a market-leading manufacturer of various types of customized expansion joints for industrial applications. Since the company was founded in 1963 by Keld Ellentoft, we have specialized in fabric expansion joints, metal expansion joints, and rubber expansion joints.

The Position

You will become part of a dynamic and international company, were, based at our production facility in Ringkøbing, you will play a key role in our manufacturing operations. You will work with the welding of high-quality products and contribute to ensuring that our production meets the highest standards of quality, safety, and efficiency.

At the same time, you will join a strong team environment where collaboration, professional development, and continuous improvement are key priorities.

Key Responsibilities

·         TIG welding of stainless steel.

·         Welding using semi-automatic welding fixtures.

·         Manufacturing of expansion joints.

·         Inspection and verification of weld quality.

·         Compliance with applicable quality requirements, work instructions, WPSs (Welding Procedure Specifications), and SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures).

Your Qualifications

You have experience welding stainless steel and possess a solid understanding of applicable quality requirements, including EN ISO 5817, Quality Level B. You work in a structured and independent manner, have a strong focus on quality, and take pride in delivering precise and well-executed work.

In addition, you are able to read and understand technical drawings according to Danish standards and communicate effectively in both Danish and English.

Personal Profile

As a person, you are responsible, reliable, and take ownership of your tasks. You have a keen eye for detail and never compromise on quality. At the same time, you are flexible, cooperative, and contribute positively to a good working environment.

You thrive in a fast-paced production environment where efficiency, quality, and on-time delivery are essential.

What We Offer

We offer an exciting position in an international company where you will become part of a workplace characterized by strong professionalism, excellent teamwork, and a commitment to safety.

You will work alongside skilled and dedicated colleagues in a professional environment where employee well-being and development are prioritized. The role involves working with high-quality products using modern production equipment, and you will have ongoing opportunities to develop your technical competencies and strengthen your qualifications within welding and manufacturing processes.

The working culture is informal, and you will join a team of engaged and motivated colleagues in an inspiring work environment. For the right candidate, there are excellent opportunities for both professional and personal development.

Start Date

EagleBurgmann KE A/S, Steen Møller Nielsen, HR Manager, Odinsvej 1, 6950 Ringkøbing, Denmark

jobs.occupation: BSc Tutor Coordinator 2027
jobs.description:
Now looking for tutor coordinators for study start 2027 

Are you a bachelor student and do you want to create a good and inclusive study start for our new students? Are you interested in making a difference for your new fellow students – and develop your own skillset? Then you could be one of our next tutor coordinators we are looking for. 

At CBS, we do our utmost to ensure that all our new bachelor students have a positive and successful study start. In 2027, we are introducing an exciting new role that gives you the opportunity to share your experiences and help new students navigate their transition to university life, from the first welcome during intro week to the weeks following their first semester exams. 

We are looking for tutor coordinators who are interested in developing a study start environment during the first study year in which well-being and learning go hand in hand, and who can ensure an inclusive, fun, and educational study start that allows everyone to feel welcome. We are looking for students who are driven to create and implement a study start, so that all students, regardless of identity and background, get a good start to their life at CBS. 

For each bachelor programme, we will recruit a team of tutor coordinators who are prepared to work together to come up with new, creative solutions. The team is responsible for the study start throughout the first study year which includes the recruitment of tutors, making the budget for the study start programme, and three tutor meetings during the first study year etc. 

Your tasks as tutor coordinator include: 

• plan and coordinate study start activities targeted at first-year students in week 34 
• plan and execute three study-related tutor meetings during the first study year 
• plan a study start that contains academic, practical and social elements with a focus on activities and communities that are inclusive for a wide diversity of students 
• recruit and form a diverse team of voluntary tutors (1 tutor per 10 new students) for the intro week 
• lead and motivate the tutors to work dedicatedly and seriously with a good study start for all new students 
• ensure good cooperation with and between the voluntary tutors and with your programme and CBS 
• keep the overview and show involving and engaging leadership 
• As part of the role, you will also act as a digital tutor for prospective students in the lead-up to the Quota 2 application deadline in the spring semester of 2028. This means you will have a profile on CBS.dk, where prospective students can read about your experiences and contact you by email with questions about student life at CBS. 
The task also requires: 

That you can work in a structured manner, both individually and in collaboration with others. In the position, you are responsible for the study start, within the framework set by CBS. In addition, it is essential that you, as a coordinator, sign, comply with and hold your tutors responsible for CBS' Rules on good ethical behaviour during the study start, and that in this connection you can set boundaries with your fellow students if necessary. CBS is always available for guidance and sparring in difficult situations. 

It is a prerequisite that you can start on 1 March 2027, and that you can work throughout week 34 in which the induction activities take place as well as three tutor meetings during the first study year and be available on mail as a digital tutor in the spring semester 2028. During spring until august 2027, you must participate in a training programme for all tutor coordinators, which consists of: 

• 2 digital training modules prior to the training days 
• Training Day 1 for tutor coordinators on 5 March 2027 
• Training Day 2 for tutor coordinators and tutors with True North in week 15 or 16 
• Training Day 3 for tutor coordinators on 10 May 2027 
• Training Day 4 for tutor coordinators and tutors on 25 or 26 May 
• Training Day 5 for tutor coordinators on 2 September 2027 
In addition, you will participate in various coordination meetings with your tutor team and in joint status meeting(s), and a touchdown meeting in week 33. 

We offer: 

• An exciting and versatile position with a good salary 
• The possibility of giving new students a great start to their studies 
• A strong influence on the development of the study start on your programme 
• A training course, which will prepare you for the task, and gives you skills in facilitation, conversation techniques, and relational work etc. 
• Leadership experience as well as experience in coordination, planning and cooperation with many different agents across CBS 
• A large network across CBS with other students and employees 
Salary and terms of employment 

Your employment will begin on 1 March 2027 and runs until 31 July 2028. 

You will be remunerated with 130 hours in accordance with the applicable collective agreement between the Danish Ministy of Finance, the National Union of Student-workers (SUL) and the Association of Danish Medical Students (FADL). Your salary will be provided on the same terms and conditions as those applicable to a student guidance counsellor (on student employment). The hourly wage is DKK 231.34 as of 1 August 2026. The salary is paid in installments once a month, starting 31 March 2027. 

Most of your tasks will be during the spring and fall semester of 2027. 

If you want to know more about the position, you are welcome to contact us at BSC-Studystart@cbs.dk. 

How to apply 

You apply online by filling in the application form and attach your application, certificate of enrollment, grade transcript and CV. 

In the application field, please state “Application Tutor Coodinator + name + which programme you are in”. 

Deadline for application is 3 January 2027. 

We expect to conduct recruitment interviews in week 1 – 5 2027. 

Apply for position

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

CBS is a globally recognised business school with deep roots in the Nordic socio-economic model. Our faculty has a broad focus on societal challenges, and we have earned a reputation for high-quality disciplinary and interdisciplinary research and education.
We are located at Frederiksberg and have approximately 20,000 full and part-time students, 800 full-time faculty members, 200 PhD students and 700 administrative staff, and a full portfolio of bachelor, master, MBA/EMBA, PhD and executive programmes taught in English and Danish.
Our global profile carries the obligation to address critical challenges in our research and to develop the transformational capabilities of students, graduates and business leaders via our educational activities and opportunities for lifelong learning. Complex challenges call for joint action, and therefore our strategy focuses on strengthening current and starting new partnerships with other sciences, the business community, authorities and civil society.
CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ identity, cultural background etc. to apply.Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.

jobs.occupation: Clinical Trial Program Lead
jobs.description:
Join a leading international life science company in an exciting role and assume end-to-end responsibility for a high-impact role at the intersection of operational strategy and execution.

Lead a Complex Global Clinical Study with strategic impact

As Clinical Trial Program Lead, you will play a key role in shaping and executing the company’ clinical development strategy. Reporting to the Head of Clinical Operations, you will assume responsibility for a strategically important Global Clinical Study while influencing the future direction of the company’s development portfolio.

Operating in an outsourced model, you will provide strategic oversight of CROs and external partners, ensuring clinical programs are delivered to the highest standards of quality, compliance, timelines, and budget. You will serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders, driving cross-functional decision-making, managing program risks, and translating development objectives into successful execution.

Beyond study delivery, you will contribute to lifecycle management, portfolio development, and the evaluation of future business opportunities, combining scientific insight, business acumen, and operational excellence to create long-term value. This is a highly visible role offering a rare combination of strategic influence, broad organizational exposure, and ownership of complex global development activities.

Global Clinical Study Leadership in an outsourced setup

You bring extensive experience from the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry and a proven track record of leading complex global clinical development programs. Operating in fully outsourced environments, you have successfully provided strategic oversight of CROs and external partners while maintaining accountability for quality, timelines, budgets, and study outcomes.

You combine a strong understanding of clinical development, global regulatory requirements, and ICH-GCP with the ability to translate scientific and business objectives into executable strategies. With sound business acumen and a strategic mindset, you are comfortable influencing senior stakeholders, navigating complex matrix organizations, and driving cross-functional decisions that create value and accelerate delivery.

Personally, you thrive in environments characterized by complexity, accountability, and change. You balance strategic perspective with operational pragmatism, bringing sound judgment, resilience, and a strong sense of ownership to everything you do. Through credibility and collaboration, you create alignment across stakeholders and build momentum around shared objectives.

Most importantly, you are motivated by shaping the direction of clinical development programs, challenging established thinking, and delivering meaningful outcomes for patients, the business, and the broader development portfolio.

jobs.occupation: Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad
jobs.description:
Bigadan is built by people with deep professional expertise and a shared ambition: to create the circular energy solutions of the future. We have been building biogas plants for more than 40 years, in Denmark and abroad, and the coming years are busy. We have expansion and greenfield projects lined up in Denmark and Scandinavia, plus support projects for our clients in Germany and the UK. That is why we are looking for an experienced Site Manager for our Projects team.

Anywhere from 10 to 50+ people from different contractors on site, all needing to deliver at the same time. You are the one holding it all together. And when you hand over, you leave behind a plant that produces biogas for decades.

The role

You lead the site day to day from ground-breaking through commissioning and handover to operations. The people on site are mainly contractors in civil, mechanical, electrical, piping and process works. You report formally to Head of Projects Luke Morris, while Head of Site Managers Stefan Wussow is your manager in day-to-day operations. You work closely with the individual Project Managers and the Site team.

You spend around 80% of your time on site and 20% in the office. Our construction site office and workshop are based in Husum, Germany. Ideally, we would like you to be based in southern Denmark near Kliplev or Husum, but as the role involves a lot of travel, we are recruiting across Denmark and northern Germany. Our projects are spread across Denmark and abroad, including Sweden, Germany, Finland and the UK.

We expect you to be ready for periods of 3–4 weeks living near the site. Employment can be in Denmark or in Germany.

What you do

Site leadership. You coordinate daily activities and contractor progress, plan access, deliveries and lifting operations, and solve problems before they become delays.

Safety. You lead site inspections and toolbox talks and approve risk assessments and method statements. You set the standard on site.

Quality and documentation. You make sure the work follows drawings and specifications, including welding, and keep track of inspections and documentation.

Handover. You manage punch lists and close-out, so we hand over a plant that works from day one.

What makes this role specific

With us, you are not building for a client you will never see again. We operate the plants ourselves afterwards, and our own colleagues will live with what you build for many years. You succeed in this role when you have led the next builds safely to completion, made the right decisions along the way, kept the budget on track, and made both the collaboration and the construction succeed.

We imagine that you:

• have a technical education, e.g. as a mechanical engineer, or a trade background (civil, mechanical or electrical) with hands-on experience

• have at least 5 years' experience as a site manager on industrial, energy, utility or process projects

• know civil, mechanical and electrical works and the health and safety rules on a construction site

• speak and write English and either Danish or German

Experience in biogas or anaerobic digestion is an advantage, but not a requirement. It is also an advantage if you hold a Danish construction safety coordinator certificate (AMK-B), first aid, knowledge of ATEX zones, or experience with welding coordination.

As a person, you are visible on site and make decisions when they need to be made. You can push back on a contractor and still have a good working relationship the next day.

We offer

A central role in a growing company, where you are involved from ground-breaking until the plant is running. You get a competitive salary, either mileage at the official Danish rates or a company van, accommodation and per diem on projects, pension and health insurance, ongoing training and support for relevant certifications. The position is full-time, starting 1 February or 1 March 2027.

About Bigadan

We develop, build, operate and own biogas plants and work across the entire value chain, from sourcing organic residues to producing energy, biogenic CO₂ and biofertiliser. We are around 200 colleagues and have built more than 40 biogas plants in Denmark and abroad.

Every day, we turn manure, food waste and other organic residues into products of value for the energy, agriculture and industrial sectors. This supports security of supply, makes better use of resources and returns nutrients to the soil.

Interested?

The application deadline is Wednesday 30 December 2026. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. If you have questions, please contact Head of Projects Luke Morris on +45 3073 6851 or lm@bigadan.dk.

jobs.occupation: Backend Developer - .NET, Azure and AI
jobs.description:
Building an AI prototype is one thing. Making it secure, reliable and useful in everyday work is another.

At Metroselskabet, you will help turn AI and modern cloud technology into practical tools that colleagues can rely on — connecting internal knowledge, data and business systems, with clear access controls and results that can be checked.

We are looking for a backend developer who combines strong software engineering skills with hands-on AI experience. You will work on solutions from the first idea through to production and ongoing operation, helping shape both how they are built and how they perform in practice.

The workplace behind Copenhagen’s metro

Metroselskabet owns, plans and builds Copenhagen’s metro. Behind the trains and stations is a workplace where colleagues across engineering, construction, operations, IT and business functions work together on the infrastructure the city depends on.

Digital development is connected to that work. In this role, your contribution will be through the tools colleagues use: helping them find relevant knowledge, work across systems and complete tasks more effectively. You will work close to the people using your solutions and see how technical choices translate into everyday improvements.

Your role

You will build and maintain backend services, APIs and integrations using .NET/C# and Azure. Alongside conventional software development, you will develop AI-powered applications that combine internal information with controlled, clearly defined actions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing well-structured, testable backend services with clear API contracts.

• Building AI solutions using Azure OpenAI and/or Microsoft Foundry, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and controlled workflows with tool calling.

• Connecting applications to internal data sources and systems, with appropriate access controls and traceable source references.

• Bringing solutions into production through automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring and robust error handling.

• Working with colleagues across business functions, IT, security and operations to understand needs, prioritise improvements and deliver practical results.

We value sound judgement. Sometimes the right solution is AI. Sometimes it is a straightforward integration, a better search function or a simpler process.

What you can expect at Metroselskabet

You will join an informal workplace with a short distance to colleagues and decisions. We combine high professional standards with trust in how people approach their work — and room for a sustainable working life.

In this role, that means taking responsibility for solutions throughout their lifecycle while working with colleagues on requirements, technical choices, security and day-to-day use. You will have room to propose improvements, discuss trade-offs and help shape solutions rather than simply implement a fixed specification.

What you bring

You are a strong backend developer who takes ownership, enjoys collaborating and cares about what happens after deployment.

We are particularly looking for:

• Solid .NET/C# experience, including ASP.NET Core, APIs, integrations, asynchronous programming and automated testing.

• Practical Azure experience, including application hosting, identity and access management, secrets management, monitoring and secure deployment. Familiarity with Docker, infrastructure as code and CI/CD is important.

• Hands-on AI engineering experience, including model integration, prompt design, structured outputs and function/tool calling.

• An understanding of RAG, including document processing, embeddings, search and retrieval, source references and evaluation — with attention to answer quality, not just whether the application produces a response.

• A production and security mindset, with attention to reliability, performance, costs, data protection and clearly defined access boundaries.

You use AI tools actively and critically in your own development work, providing relevant context and validating the output rather than accepting it at face value.

Experience with MCP, Open WebUI, LiteLLM or local models is a plus, but not a requirement. We do not expect you to know every technology in our stack.

How you work

You can turn an unclear request into a well-defined problem and a practical solution. You explain technical choices in plain language and communicate progress, trade-offs and risks openly.

You work independently while involving others when needed, and you take responsibility for documentation, quality and continuous improvement.

You are curious about new technology without being driven by hype. You understand AI’s limitations, take GDPR and responsible data use seriously, and enjoy sharing your knowledge so colleagues can make informed use of AI themselves.

Application deadline

Please submit your application no later than 21st of December.

For any questions about the role you may contact the Team Manager, Andreas Utzon-Frank, auf@m.dk

At Metroselskabet, we see diversity as a strength that contributes to the company’s innovative problem-solving and continued development. Metroselskabet is a diverse workplace with many nationalities and professional profiles represented, and we work continuously to strengthen inclusion, belonging, and cohesion among our employees. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply for the position.

At Metroselskabet, you become part of an organization where you and your 400 colleagues take on a task of great importance: delivering world-class metro services—now and for many generations to come. It is a responsibility that truly matters. You will work on complex tasks within a strong professional community alongside supportive colleagues and managers who create the right environment for innovation. From day one, you will have influence by contributing new ideas and taking responsibility for our shared success. If you would like to learn more about working at Metroselskabet and see our other open positions, please visit our website here.

jobs.occupation: Consultancy in Otorhinolaryngology, head and neck surgery combined with a clinical professorship with special focus on Digital Surgery and Technology in Surgery
jobs.description:
A clinical position as consultant of Otorhinolaryngology at the Department of ORL, Head and neck surgery and audiology at Copenhagen University Hospital - Rigshospitalet is open for appointment from as soon as possible.

The position is combined with a 5-year externally funded position as clinical professor in Otorhinolaryngology and Head and Neck Surgery combined with a clinical professorship with special focus in Digital Surgery and Technology in Surgery, University of Copenhagen.

The position is advertised in accordance with §8 (Bekendtgørelse om ansættelse af videnskabeligt personale ved universiteter).

It is a requirement that the applicant is accepted for appointment of both the professorship and the consultancy.

About the department

The Department of Otorhinolaryngology and Audiology is responsible for the full spectrum of diagnostics and treatment within the ENT and audiological fields, encompassing both general patient care and highly specialized services. A total of more than 100 clinically active physicians is employed within the department. In addition, there is a high level of research activity, including among the clinical staff. The department currently has five formally affiliated professors, three of whom are clinical professors in otorhinolaryngology. As a university hospital department, it also has teaching obligations at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels, including for healthcare professionals beyond the medical field of both the primary and secondary health sector.

Clinical functions and focus areas of the department

The consultant position in otology and neurotology requires strong interest and clinical interest in middle ear and inner ear diseases. The ideal candidate will demonstrate solid experience in teaching and research, including involvement in undergraduate and postgraduate education, as well as supervision of PhD students. Emphasis is placed on candidates with a robust and continuous research background. The candidate is expected to have extensive knowledge and research experience with otological diseases, innovative and digital surgery. A broad knowledge of classic ENT conditions is also expected. Further the candidate should be active and involved in novel teaching algorithms and adjacent research areas. Also, the candidate is expected to take the responsibility of the Temporal Bone and Simulation Laboratory at Copenhagen Hearing and Balance Center at Rigshospitalet with the purpose of elaborating on the use of cone beam CT and other imaging tools in clinical oto-surgical assessments.

The position offers significant opportunities for further specialization and skill development within advanced surgical techniques, including the potential for building up ear robotic surgery. The consultant will also be expected to take on administrative responsibilities such as patient triage and task coordination.

As the department provides highly specialized ENT services at a university level, applicants must have documented surgical experience and demonstrated research interest.

Applicants must submit documentation of board certification in Otorhinolaryngology. According to the regulations of the Capital Region of Denmark, applicants must have held a specialist certification for at least five years to be appointed as a consultant at Rigshospitalet, unless an exemption is granted. Furthermore, applicants must provide evidence of clinical experience within otology and neurotology, as well as documentation of scientific and educational activities.

Strong collaboration skills are essential, including the ability to work professionally and constructively in interdisciplinary teams.

Organizationally, the consultant will report to the Head of Department. For professional matters related specifically to otology and neurotology, reference will be made to the lead consultant in that subspecialty.

We offer a dynamic and rewarding position in a busy and active department housed in brand-new, state-of-the-art facilities. The position includes excellent opportunities for involvement in research and clinical development.

Work Schedule: The position includes on-call duty (approximately every 14 days), shared equally among the department’s consultants.

Please note: The position is subject to regulations requiring a child protection certificate ("børneattest"). Employment is contingent upon the ability to present a clean certificate.

Salary and Employment Conditions

The position is subject to the Collective Agreement for Specialist Doctors and Consultant Physicians (Overlæger) and the applicable Working Time Agreement between the Danish Regions and the relevant medical professional organization.

Detailed information on employment conditions, collective agreements, and salary levels can be found here:

• Collective Agreement: https://laeger.dk/foreninger/overlaegeforeningen/ok26-overlaegeforeningen

• Collective Agreement (PDF): https://laeger.dk/media/15odzzl1/overenskomst-for-speciallaeger-og-overlaeger-2026.pdf

• Salary information: https://www.regionh.dk/om-region-hovedstaden/fakta/arbejdsplads/sider/startloen.aspx

As clinical professor at least 50 % of the working time will be allocated to academic tasks (e.g., research, teaching, evaluation tasks and communication with the public) in agreement with the Head of Department of Department of Clinical Medicine at the University of Copenhagen. The remaining time will be allocated for clinical work in agreement with the head of Department of ORL, Head and neck surgery and audiology, Rigshospitalet. Additional support and details on the working conditions must be negotiated with the head of the department of Department of ORL, Head and neck surgery and audiology, Rigshospitalet.

Research and teaching

With the establishment of the new position as Consultant in Otorhinolaryngology and Clinical Professor in Oto-rhino-laryngology with special focus on Digital Surgery and Technology in Surgery, the Department of Otorhinolaryngology, Head and Neck Surgery and Audiology seek to significantly strengthen leadership and strategic development within clinical research, teaching and innovation. The professorship is conceived as a pivotal academic and clinical role that will unify and advance research activities across the specialty, with a particular emphasis on translational and interdisciplinary digital surgery.

The position will serve as an academic anchor not only for Rigshospitalet but also for Nordsjællands Hospital and, more broadly, for Region Østdanmark (RØST), with the explicit ambition of fostering coordinated research efforts across Eastern Denmark. The clinical professor is expected to provide academic leadership, facilitate collaboration between hospital departments and regional research environments, and contribute to the development of shared research strategies and priorities across institutions.

In research, the position entails responsibility for initiating, leading, and consolidating high-quality clinical and translational research programmes within clinical innovation and digital surgery and related disciplines. This includes strengthening existing research groups, promoting multicentre and cross-regional studies, supporting early-career researchers, and ensuring integration of research activities across hospitals within RØST. The professor will play a key role in attracting external funding, enhancing national and international visibility, and embedding research as a core component of clinical practice throughout Eastern Denmark.

In teaching, the position carries responsibility for academic leadership in undergraduate, postgraduate, and continuing medical education within otorhinolaryngology and head and neck surgery. The professor will contribute to curriculum development, pedagogical innovation, and supervision at all levels, ensuring alignment between clinical training, academic standards, and regional workforce needs. Teaching activities will be coordinated across clinical sites, thereby supporting a unified and high-quality educational environment for medical students, residents, and fellows within RØST.

Overall, the position is designed to function as a unifying professorship that integrates research, teaching, and clinical excellence across Nordsjællands Hospital, the wider hospital network in RØST, and academic partners, thereby strengthening the academic foundation and future development of the specialty across Eastern Denmark.

Qualifications

Applicants must be board-certified specialist in Oto-rhino-laryngology.

Application procedure

The application must include the following:

• 
Curriculum Vitae and a complete list of publications

• 
Copy of the authorization certificate for specialist in Otorhinolaryngology.

• 
A description of how the applicant is qualified as

• 
Clinical expert

• 
Communicator

• 
Collaborator

• 
Manager/administrator/organizer

• 
Health advocate

• 
Scholar/researcher/teacher

• 
Professional

For more information, please refer to Sundhedsstyrelsen: The Seven Roles of Physicians.

The closing date for applications is December 10th, 2026

Further information

For further information please contact Head of Department Mads Klokker tel. + 45 3545 6033, or email: mads.klokker@regionh.dk.

• Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in cloud data transformation platforms such as Azure Databricks, AWS, or GCP; relevant certifications are a plus.

• Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in Python or equivalent scripting languages is a must.

Technical Expertise:

• Proficient in Structured Query Language (SQL) and experienced in working with relational databases and cloud-based data platforms.

• Experience with Microsoft Azure data services and Databricks, including technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Delta Lake, Python, and PySpark.

• Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data ingestion, transformation, incremental processing, and data quality practices.

• Experience in data modeling and layered data architectures, including Medallion architecture and dimensional modeling concepts.

• Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, DevOps practices, and CI/CD processes is a plus.

• Good understanding of Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA data models and data sources across HR and Sales functions.

• Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik is essential.

Soft-skills:

• Strong consulting mindset with the ability to work independently on defined tasks and collaborate effectively within medium to large-scale project teams.

• Proven ability to work in dynamic, fast-paced project environments without compromising on quality.

• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE life science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

jobs.occupation: Electrical & Automation System Specialist
jobs.description:
Job Description

Shape the Future of Engineering Digitalization

As our Electrical Design & Automation Systems Specialist, you will take ownership of our global engineering application landscape, with a strong focus on EPLAN, Siemens SIMATIC (TIA Portal) and related engineering systems.

Working at the interface of Electrical Engineering, Automation and IT, you will drive engineering digitalization, improve global standards and processes, and enable scalable engineering solutions across our international organization.

This is a highly visible role with the opportunity to influence global engineering standards, application strategy, and future engineering workflows.

Your Responsibilities

• Drive the development and continuous improvement of our global electrical design and machine control tool landscape

• Own and continuously develop the global EPLAN and engineering applications landscape

• Drive integration with PLM, ERP and other enterprise systems

• Collaborate with Engineering, Automation and IT teams worldwide

• Translate business requirements into scalable application solutions

• Lead and support international digitalization and application projects

• Drive standardization, process harmonization and data quality improvements

• Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for global stakeholders

• Identify opportunities to increase efficiency, automation and engineering excellence

Your Profile

Must-Have

• Degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a comparable qualification

• Professional experience with EPLAN or comparable engineering applications

• Understanding of electrical engineering design processes and engineering data structures

• Basic understanding of automation environments and PLC engineering processes.

• Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills

• Fluent English skills

Nice-to-Have

• Experience with Siemens automation solutions (e.g. SIMATIC)

• Knowledge of SAP PLM, SAP ECTR, Autodesk Vault or similar PLM/PDM systems

• Experience with engineering application administration and system integrations

• Knowledge of IT service management, deployment or application lifecycle processes

Why Join Us?

• Own globally used engineering applications with direct business impact

• Shape the future of engineering digitalization in an international environment

• Work at the intersection of Electrical Engineering, Automation and IT

• Drive global standards, innovation and process improvements

• Collaborate with experts across multiple locations

• Build a strong global network by collaborating with engineering, automation and IT experts across the organization

Join us and help shape the next generation of digital engineering excellence.

About BEUMER Group

Conveying, loading, palletizing, packing, sorting and distributing – BEUMER Group develops and produces technically leading intralogistics systems for the global market. Our employees are characterized by excellent know‑how and a strong will to consistently develop themselves further. We do our utmost to promote this claim: within the framework of a family‑like cooperation characterized by high mutual esteem and a culture of trust that creates stability and security. Our common goal: to implement outstanding and innovative projects worldwide.

Additional Information

We look forward to receiving your application! Please include your salary expectations (gross annual salary) and your notice period or earliest possible starting date.

WHAT BENEFITS DO WE OFFER?

• 
We offer exciting opportunities in an internationally operating family-owned company with locations in more than 70 countries – including the opportunity to temporarily work from one of our international locations as part of our Flex Abroad Program.

• 
During our immersive onboarding program in, you will receive an extensive overview of BEUMER Group, our history, and our vision for the future, whilst also getting to know your new colleagues.

• 
Through a culture of open feedback, transparent corporate updates, and regular employee events, we actively cultivate a friendly, open, and collaborative working environment

• 
Your personal and professional growth is integral to our ethos. We champion your development through a wide range of training courses and upskilling opportunities — including support for external courses and grants for trainees.

• 
Flexible working hours and the choice of operating from a remote office are important components of our modern work culture, much like our bright, spacious offices and ergonomically optimized workstations.

• 
Your health matters to us. Enjoy free access to our on-site fitness centre and join one of our many sports clubs for a healthier, more connected work-life. We also provide computer glasses subsidies, vegetarian lunch options, and free fresh fruit to help boost your well-being.

• 
You will get access to Denmark’s largest discount portal, and receive exclusive discounts and promotional offers from a wide-range of companies and businesses.

• 
From accident insurance to attractive company pension schemes and health insurance for you and your children, we are committed to supporting your long-term well-being.

• 
Supporting you when you are not in work is also important to us. Our Staff Association organizes and sponsors social, cultural, and sporting activities, including our annual Christmas and Summer parties, which are always great fun.

• 
Sustainability is one of our key core values, which we tackle on multiple fronts. For example, you will have access to our electric charging stations in the employee parking area, with the electricity being provided at cost price.

• 
Fair pay is extended to all our employees, and we ensure we provide a balanced and equitable remuneration framework. You will also receive a number of additional salary benefits that combine to form an attractive salary package.

• 
Everyone needs a rest and a break from work at some point. That is why you will receive 30 days of vacation days per year, as well as various other special holiday days. We also provide extra support for maternity and paternity leave.

jobs.occupation: Terminal Operator
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working in a close team where quality, safety, and flexibility truly matter? Are you curious by nature, technically inclined, and motivated by variety rather than routine? Then this might be your next step.

We are now looking for a terminal operator to strengthen our team in Frederikshavn. This role is ideal for someone who wants to be part of a dynamic shipping environment and contribute to the future of terminal and bunker operations.

**Why This Role Is Different

**This is not a one-track job. As a terminal operator, you will combine hands on operational work with administrative and technical responsibilities. You will be part of a small team where each individual contributes with their own strengths, whether within engineering, maintenance, safety systems, electrical work, or operational coordination.

You will share daily tasks and responsibilities with your colleagues while also using your experience to strengthen different parts of the operation.

**Your Day-to-Day Impact

**Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Support safe and efficient cargo handling and storage operations

• Supervise the technical and safety condition of the terminal

• Work in shifts with shared responsibility

• Operate both independently and as part of a team, depending on the situation

**Beyond the Terminal

**In addition to managing the terminal, we also operate a fleet of highly modern bunker tankers.

During periods of low terminal activity or when rapid response is required, you may support our shipping operations. This can include assisting with immediate repairs, handling administrative tasks, or supporting crew changes and operational coordination.

**Who You Are

**You thrive in an environment where things move quickly, and priorities may change at short notice. You remain calm under pressure, adapt easily, and are comfortable working outside normal office hours.

You are someone who:

• Is passionate about your work and enjoys variety

• Handles change without becoming stressed

• Appreciates structured processes while remaining flexible

• Is proactive, reliable, and solution oriented

**Your Background

**We value experience, but we value motivation and willingness to learn just as highly.

We welcome applicants with backgrounds such as:

• Marine experience, deck or engine

• Terminal operations

• Cargo surveying

• Technical, electrical, maintenance, or safety related roles

You should be able to communicate clearly in English and one Scandinavian language, both spoken and written, and have completed at least high school education.

You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues who are committed to supporting your development and helping you build new skills.

**About OljOla Shipping and Terminals

**OljOla Shipping and Terminals is an established company within the tanker shipping industry, founded in 1978 with roots on Donsö Island. We specialise in the distribution of bunkers and operate a highly modern fleet of bunker tankers.

Our ambition is to become a leading bunker and terminal operator through strong operational efficiency, technical innovation, safety, and sustainability.

Since 2020, we have been established in the Port of Frederikshavn, Denmark. After supporting the construction phase of the oil terminal, we are now entering the next stage and strengthening the operation. This is an exciting time to join us.

Your employment

• The position is based in Frederikshavn

• Full time employment as a shift operator

• Six months probationary employment

• Insurance and occupational pension in accordance with standard practice

Please submit your application, including CV and personal letter, at your earliest convenience.
